answer: Slash-stake. Agents deposit a locked stake that is progressively burned if repeated peer checks expose low-quality or contradictory activity. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must post fresh non-recoverable collateral for each and face total loss on detection%2C raising Sybil cost far above any reward. In the copper trellis a clear mirror of genuine growth%2C mass fabrication becomes ruinous.
